excerpt: Transcribes prerecorded audio and video files through an API.
Provide a URL: Submit a URL to a publicly accessible audio file. This is the standard method and is suitable for most use cases.
Upload a file: Upload an audio file directly. This method supports files up to 2 GiB and is ideal for large files or local media.
Transcribe long-form audio files up to 24 hours or 2 GiB in size.
Use the two-letter ISO 639-1 language codes from the following table (e.g., en for English, es for Spanish)
If not provided, the language will be auto-detected for each speech segment.
Applications create transcription jobs and can receive completion updates through webhooks.
When enabled, streams progress and chronological transcription segments using SSE.
This endpoint allows you to check the status of an existing transcription job and retrieve its results if available.
The desired format for the transcription output. Valid options are srt, vtt, or webvtt. If not provided, the output will be in JSON format.
When enabled, adds speaker_id to each segment based on the speaker's voice.
When enabled, parses speakers from multi-channel audio by assigning one speaker per channel. Useful for multi-track recordings.
Add a start and end time to each word in the transcript.
Label transcript segments as speech, music, silence, and other audio types.
Use faster edge transcription for supported short-audio workflows.
Filter out segments that fall below this confidence threshold.
Duration of each transcription segment in seconds. Must be between six and 30 seconds.
When enabled, immediately redacts the original input_url and deletes the segments after 12 hours.
Custom user agent header to fetch the audio file.
both audio-only and video files with audio tracks are accepted.
